Hi Bryce — thanks for the HAR and logs, very helpful. Summary of what we saw and next steps: 

Root cause: cross-domain cookie and redirect ordering. The invite flow issues a cookie scoped to .coupa.com but the coupa.brycechem.com redirect doesn't include the cookie due to SameSite=Lax and the way the sequence does a POST/302. That causes the session to be lost and the UI to fall back to the sign-in start (the "flash" you saw).

Short-term mitigation (deliverable within hours):
- We've generated a tenant-override invite hosted on the shared coupa.com domain (link sent to you in a separate secure message). Please use that link to complete onboarding for the two suppliers — it avoids the coupa.brycechem.com redirect.
- I asked Platform to temporarily set the cookie attribute to SameSite=None for cross-site activation while you finish the batch; Platform ticket: PN-4821 (link above).

Longer-term next steps:
- If your team prefers tenant-hosted invites, we'll coordinate with your network/IdP to ensure the coupa.brycechem.com host is covered by the cookie domain and that any SSO handoffs keep the cookie intact (work with your SRE).
- We'll add an automated test in the invite pipeline to detect cross-domain cookie drops.

I'll follow up once PN-4821 is merged; for now please confirm the two supplier names and I'll prioritize the manual invites. Apologies for the disruption — we know PO timing matters.
